statements.quote: We expect to increase, relative to 2023, our investment in our technical infrastructure, including servers, network equipment, and data centers, to support the growth of our business and our long-term initiatives, in particular in support of AI products and services.
statements.notes: No target year is named; 2023 is only the comparison baseline, so fiscal_year is null. The same sentence also appears in p01. AI is given as a driver of total technical infrastructure investment, and no AI-specific amount is stated.

statements.quote: We continue to make significant research and development investments in areas of strategic focus as we seek to develop new, innovative offerings, improve our existing offerings, and rapidly and responsibly deploy AI across our businesses.
statements.notes: Present-tense ongoing R&D investment, with AI deployment named as one of several goals. The link to AI spend is loose and no amount or share is given.
